summary: Karakeep is a self-hosted application designed for saving bookmarks, links, and text snippets. It incorporates artificial intelligence features to assist users in managing and searching through their collected data.
goodFor: Data hoarders and individuals who want a centralised, self-hosted system to store and organise large quantities of web links and textual content.
watchOut: The AGPL-3.0 licence carries strict copyleft requirements if you modify the code and distribute it over a network. Additionally, the inclusion of AI features may introduce higher resource demands depending on how they are processed.
deployNotes: As a containerised application, it typically requires persistent volumes for data storage and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination. You should also ensure Docker and Docker Compose are available on your host system.
